title: Hide sections you don’t use
summary: Choose which services appear in the sidebar and on Home, so your app only shows what you use.

title: Choose your startup page
summary: Open directly to your favorite section, such as local media, YouTube or Jellyfin, when CoffeeFlix starts.

title: A display name and personal greeting
summary: Set a display name for the Home greeting, with more greeting phrases to make the app feel personal.

title: Turn background effects off
summary: Add a setting to disable animated background effects for a quieter interface.

title: Type without the GamePad
summary: Use the on-screen keyboard with a Wii Remote or Pro Controller, including when the GamePad is unavailable.

title: Video sizing for 4:3 TVs and CRTs
summary: Choose fit, stretch or letterbox in the player, with 4:3 output considered for older TVs.

title: Autoplay the next Jellyfin episode
summary: Continue to the next episode automatically when watching a series, with an option to turn it off.

title: Stream your media over FTP
summary: Browse and play files from an FTP server, including a phone acting as your home media server.

title: Calibre-Web and Kavita libraries
summary: Browse books and comics on your network and read them in CoffeeFlix, extending the local EPUB and CBZ reader.

title: Like and dislike YouTube videos
summary: Let signed-in YouTube users like and dislike videos from CoffeeFlix.

title: Return YouTube Dislike integration
summary: Show estimated dislike counts using Return YouTube Dislike.

title: DeArrow titles and thumbnails
summary: Offer community-written titles and thumbnails through DeArrow, with an option to use the originals.

title: YouTube Kids profile support
summary: Explore whether YouTube Kids profiles can be supported. Profile access and account compatibility need investigation.

title: Sign in to Twitch
summary: Connect a Twitch account and access account features, such as your followed channels.

title: Watch Twitch VODs
summary: Browse and play past Twitch broadcasts alongside live streams.

title: Automatically collect Twitch channel points
summary: Explore collecting available channel point bonuses while watching signed in. Feasibility and service support need checking.

title: Twitch chat, emotes and polls
summary: Read chat with 7TV and BTTV emotes, and explore support for polls and predictions where possible.

title: Explore a Wii version
summary: Investigate a smaller version for the original Wii. Hardware limits would affect the features and video quality it could support.
